post.description:
Parse an .ork into draft rocket and recovery sections, with an import report.

With a thrust curve, the draft also gets a motor and the report gets
flight cross-checks (apogee, max Mach, rail exit, centre of pressure)
against OpenRocket's own saved simulation.

Fetch a motor's RASP (.eng) curve from ThrustCurve.org and store it.

Needs internet. Fetched curves are stored like uploads, so they work
offline afterwards.

Import a mission.yaml or a .mission.zip bundle (any schema version).

A bundle's assets are hash-checked and added to the asset store, so the
mission can be flown straight away.

Check a mission config without storing or simulating it.

Accepts any schema version; older configs are migrated first. Always
returns 200 with a report: errors block a run, warnings do not.

result. With ``wait_s`` the request waits for the job and usually returns
it done; otherwise it returns 202 with a job to poll.
